name: Thule Sleek Adapter Kit (Double Mode)
seatBrandsSupported: Frame-conversion kit (upper + lower adapters) that reconfigures the Thule Sleek into a sibling/double stroller — enables a second seat, bassinet, or car seat position. For a Clek Liing in the second position it is paired with the Maxi-Cosi car seat adapter 11000300 (which carries the Liing/Maxi-Cosi/BeSafe/Cybex/Nuna footprint).
_statusNote: Current product but 'Temporarily out of stock' at Thule DTC (2026-07-05). Compatible with both the original Thule Sleek and the Sleek 2.

install.notes: Upper and lower adapters configure the Sleek into a sibling stroller; car seat use in the second position additionally requires the Maxi-Cosi car seat adapter 11000300.

notes: This is the SECOND-SEAT/DOUBLE-MODE kit Clek's list pairs with '11000300 (x2)' for the Sleek in double mode. It is a frame conversion kit, not a car-seat footprint adapter on its own — the Clek Liing rides on the 11000300 Maxi-Cosi adapter mounted onto this kit. Thule DTC $59.95 (out of stock at check). Only needed for double-mode car-seat carriage (thule-sleek-double).
